test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct Passive form of the given sentence.

Where did you find my luggage?

options.text: Where do you found my luggage?
Where will my luggage be found?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Where did you find my luggage?"
 
• To convert to passive voice, the object "my luggage" becomes the subject.
 
• The verb "did find" is changed to its passive form "was found."
 
• The correct passive sentence structure is: "Where was my luggage found?"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Where was my luggage found?"*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Where was my luggage found?" – This is the correct passive form of the given sentence.
 
• **Option 2: **"Where do you found my luggage?" – Incorrect grammar; "do you found" is not valid.
 
• **Option 3: **"Where is my luggage found?" – Incorrect tense; this implies a habitual action rather than a past event.
 
• **Option 4: **"Where will my luggage be found?" – Incorrect tense; this implies a future action rather than a past event.
